ParentCategory.PageMetaDescription: Designed for higher pressure fluid power applications, O-Ring Face Seal Fittings (ORFS) from Air-Way meet or exceed SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3 standards.
ParentCategory.Description:
Engineered for high-pressure fluid power applications, our ORFS fittings deliver secure, leak-free connections that meet or exceed SAE J1453 and ISO 8434-3 standards.

  • Designed to connect steel tubing with SAE J1926 / ISO 11926-1 O-ring ports for superior sealing performance.

  • The Style B Dovetail Groove design ensures reliable O-ring retention and long-lasting durability.

Available in both carbon steel and stainless steel, Air-Way ORFS fittings provide strength, precision, and corrosion resistance for your most demanding hydraulic systems.
